highlights.title: GNU social v3
highlights.description: Led the GNU social v3 rewrite from 2021 to 2022 with ~1200 commits, funded by NLnet through the NGI0 Discovery programme. Ported the federated microblogging stack to Symfony 5, with an event driven and modular architecture, rewrote controllers and the posting form layer, expanded PHPUnit coverage, integrated PHPStan and dependency-hygiene tooling

highlights.title: Blender GSoC 2019
highlights.description: Proposed replacing Blender's Python OBJ, STL, and PLY importers/exporters with a shared C/C++ IO framework using memory-mapped files and optional parallelization. A prototype patch made OBJ and STL import and export about 3× faster, and the proposal was accepted into the GSoC programme.

items.title: Fix wrong handling of combinators inside `:global()`
items.description: Reworked Astro's `compiler_rs`'s `scope_css` pass so combinators inside `:global()` hoist correctly, dropping the broken `ParserOptions::css_modules` path

items.title: JSX in object literal transforms incorrectly
items.description: Fixed JSX-in-object-literal transforms in the Astro Rust compiler so object literals can contain JSX expressions (astro#17198).

items.title: feat(BPopover): Add close-on-hide prop to close the popover when it hides by clipping out of view
items.description: Added a `close-on-hide` prop to `BPopover` so popovers dismiss when clipping middleware hides them from view.

items.title: Add support for `transition{run,start,cancel}` events
items.description: Added React support for `transitionrun`, `transitionstart`, and `transitioncancel` events, with matching test coverage.

items.title: Refresh the state between observer runs
items.description: Fixed chained Redux observers so each run sees the latest store state after upstream observers dispatch updates.

items.title: [leaflet] Forward given feature property type
items.description: Forwarded Leaflet's feature property generic through `@types/leaflet` so callers can type GeoJSON features precisely.

items.title: [leaflet] Turn on strictNullChecks and fix errors that arise
items.description: Enabled `strictNullChecks` on the Leaflet typings and fixed the resulting type errors.

items.title: Add custom variable to specify a wrapper for the determined commands to launch a console
items.description: Added an inf-ruby variable to wrap the console command, making it easy to launch Ruby inside Docker.

items.title: [leaflet] Update to leaflet 1.9.1
items.description: Brought `@types/leaflet` up to Leaflet 1.9.1.

items.title: Add `n` specifier for tuple and pair
items.description: Added an `n` format specifier for `std::tuple` and `std::pair` in {fmt}, following the tuple-formatting design from #4090.

items.title: feat(BOffcanvas): allow specifying a width
items.description: Added a width prop to `BOffcanvas` so sidebar sizing matches bootstrap-vue migration expectations.

items.title: feat(BInput): Alias BFormInput to BInput
items.description: Aliased `BFormInput` as `BInput` for bootstrap-vue compatibility.

items.title: Update README
items.description: Named the Debian package that carries the BlueZ headers in the PyBluez build requirements, so the README says what to install rather than what is needed.

items.title: Update Leaflet declaration to include missing methods, as of version 1.8
items.description: Filled in missing Leaflet methods in the DefinitelyTyped declarations for v1.8.

items.title: Add `entries` and `from_entries`, similar to JavaScript's `Object.entries` and `Object.fromEntries`
items.description: Added `entries` and `from_entries` helpers to functional-php, mirroring JavaScript's `Object.entries` / `Object.fromEntries`.

items.title: Add option to memory to allow not showing the percentage
items.description: Added an i3blocks memory option to hide the percentage label while keeping the usage bar.

items.title: Update Android Tools gradle version
items.description: Bumped Android Gradle tooling in masked-view to unblock react-native-gesture-handler builds.

items.title: Update Android Tools gradle version
items.description: Bumped Android Gradle tooling in Reanimated to unblock react-native-gesture-handler builds.

items.title: Fix build error
items.description: Fix a spurious Assimp warning tracked in assimp#3222.

items.title: [Translation] Add support for calling `trans` with ICU formatted messages
items.description: Extended Symfony's Translator so `trans()` accepts ICU-formatted messages directly (symfony#37228).

items.title: Add `ary` function which ignores arguments over the supplied number
items.description: Added `ary`, a helper that trims excess arguments before invoking a callable.

items.title: Fix tests
items.description: Repaired functional-php's PHPUnit suite after upstream dependency and PHP version drift.

items.title: Update Android Tools gradle version
items.description: Bumped Android Gradle tooling in react-native-safe-area-context to unblock a react-native-gesture-handler build.

items.title: Quarter: scale pointer position to device pixels before flipping Y
items.description: Fixed picking in the 3D view on fractional-scale screens. `toDevicePixelPosition()` flipped the Y axis in logical pixels and only then scaled to device pixels, so on a 2.67x panel a click landed 1 to 4 device pixels below the cursor.

items.title: feat: omit listed VK codes from the global key monitor
items.description: Added `WISPR_CAPTURE_IGNORE_VK`, a list of virtual-key codes the Linux helper leaves out of its global key monitor, so a push-to-talk bind on <kbd>Right Ctrl</kbd> stops firing on <kbd>Left Ctrl</kbd> as well. Skipped keys do not take a sequence index, so the app never sees a gap, and paste injection is untouched.

items.title: feat(modules): add on-enter and on-leave events
items.description: Added `on-enter` and `on-leave` command hooks to every Waybar module, requested since 2023. Ignores GTK's inferior crossings and latches on a hover flag so each command runs once per hover, and mirrors the `on-click` guard that keeps built-in actions from also running as shell commands.

items.title: Package as a Nix flake (NixOS + home-manager modules)
items.description: Packaged claude-auto-retry as a Nix flake with NixOS and home-manager modules that build from source and manage the shell wrapper, reconcile timer, and `StopFailure` hook through real options instead of `npm i -g`. Also fixed the wrapper clobbering each tmux pane's `TERM`.

items.title: rebase: add `--[no-]edit` to `--continue`
items.description: Add `git rebase --continue --no-edit` and `rebase.noEdit` to skip opening $EDITOR after resolving conflicts, with `--edit` to override the config for a single continue.

items.title: Switch to PSR-4 with XRD namespace
items.description: Modernized XML_XRD with PSR-4 autoloading under an `XRD` namespace, replacing legacy PEAR layout.

items.title: Add `setInteractive`
items.description: Added `setInteractive` on Leaflet layers so interactivity can be toggled after creation.

items.title: feat: make `optimize` return the AST and export `parseSvg` for browser bundle
items.description: Made SVGO's `optimize` return the AST and exported `parseSvg` in the browser bundle to avoid double parsing.

items.title: Update tests to PHPUnit 9.5
items.description: Updated XML_XRD tests to PHPUnit 9.5 as part of broader PEAR modernization.

items.title: Allow controls to use the 'button' role rather than requiring an <a> element
items.description: Let Leaflet controls use `role="button"` instead of requiring anchor elements in control markup.

items.title: Add option to use absolute paths
items.description: Added a GNU Stow option to emit absolute symlinks when packages must resolve outside the stow tree.

items.title: Add support for specifying extra command line options during database dump and load
items.description: Let capistrano-db-tasks pass extra mysqldump flags—needed for schemas where a non-unique key follows the primary key.

items.title: Fix deprecation warning caused by missing return types
items.description: Added missing return types on XML_XRD to clear PHP 8 deprecation warnings.

items.title: Ensure negative height is not given to `whiptail`
items.description: Clamped negative whiptail menu heights that broke item rendering from v0.52.22 onward.

items.title: Ensure negative height is not given to `whiptail`
items.description: Clamped negative whiptail menu heights that broke item rendering from v0.52.22 onward.

items.title: Add `cartesian_product` and `InvalidArgumentException::assertStringable`
items.description: Added `cartesian_product` and `InvalidArgumentException::assertStringable` to functional-php.

items.title: Add copy and paste functionality
items.description: Added copy/paste shortcuts to the Rete.js keyboard plugin for moving node selections between editor states.

items.title: Spawn context menu at mouse position, clamped to viewport
items.description: Opened the Rete.js context menu at the pointer and clamped it to the viewport edges.

items.title: Switch from `event.code` to `event.key`, to allow for remapped layouts
items.description: Switched Rete.js shortcuts from `event.code` to `event.key` so remapped and non-QWERTY layouts work.

items.title: Add `redshift` block to display the current screen temperature
items.description: Added a redshift i3blocks module that shows the current screen colour temperature.

items.title: Update dependencies so it works with Webpack 5 and CRACO 7
items.description: Updated react-scoped-css for Webpack 5 and CRACO 7 without deprecated loader APIs. Closed as implemented by the maintainer

items.title: Only define classes if they don't exist
items.description: Wrapped every Intl stub class in a `class_exists` guard, so loading the polyfill next to a real `intl` extension stops fataling with "Cannot declare class Normalizer, because the name is already in use".

items.title: Allow customizing which class gets used for `LayersControl`
items.description: Let React Leaflet's `LayersControl` instantiate a custom `L.Control` subclass—needed for image-based layer toggles.

items.title: feat(BDropdown): add prop for max height and width for the dropdown menu
items.description: Added `max-height` and `max-width` props to `BDropdown` so a menu can override the size `@floating-ui/vue` works out for it, with an example in the docs.

items.title: Pass DND Context to sorting `strategy`
items.description: Passed drag-and-drop context into dnd-kit sorting strategies so custom sorters can read sensors and collisions.

items.title: Add `initial` and `delta` to `pointerCoordinates` in `collisionDetection`
items.description: Added `initial` and `delta` pointer coordinates to dnd-kit collision detection for frame-to-frame movement.

items.title: [leaflet] Support optional altitude in LatLngTuple
items.description: Allowed optional altitude in Leaflet's `LatLngTuple` typing.

items.title: gtk4: 4.22.4 -> 4.22.5
items.description: Bumped gtk4 to 4.22.5 for upstream's munmap() fix in the Wayland dmabuf format table, which took down any GTK4 client on Hyprland whenever a monitor was plugged in. Traced from a coredump and first sent as a backported patch; the reviewer asked for the bump once 4.22.5 was tagged. Closed as a duplicate of #559510, the GNOME 51 update on staging, which takes gtk4 to 4.24.0.

items.title: Fix table in README
items.description: Fixed a malformed Markdown table in the Seastar README.

items.title: Support dynamic changing of Marker `interactive` property
items.description: Synced Leaflet marker `interactive` when the React Leaflet prop changes after mount.

items.title: feat(bootstrap-vue-next): allow specifying component aliases
items.description: Let `BootstrapVueNextResolver` take a map of component aliases, so a project moving off bootstrap-vue can keep auto-importing the names it already uses.

items.title: Fix `event clear does not exist`
items.description: Bound the missing `clear` event when the Rete.js history plugin installs, so clearing the history no longer throws (retejs/history-plugin#16).

items.title: Add explicit return types to methods overriding Symfony methods, silencing deprecation warnings
items.description: Added explicit return types on Symfony overrides in Codeception to silence Symfony 5.4 deprecations.

items.title: Update type signatures to avoid warnings in PHP 8.1
items.description: Updated getopt-php type signatures for PHP 8.1 and PHPStan cleanliness.

items.title: Update to `Doctrine` 3 and `beberlei/assert` 3.3
items.description: Upgraded cte-builder to Doctrine 3 and beberlei/assert 3.3. Closed after the maintainer folded parts of it into 3.1.0, which supports DBAL 2 and 3 side by side

items.title: Update Android Tools gralde version
items.description: Bumped Android Gradle tooling in react-native-screens to unblock gesture-handler builds.

items.title: Update Android Tools gradle version
items.description: Bumped Android Gradle tooling in the TypeScript RN template to fix Groovy/Java7 build failures.

items.title: [Translator] Document support for calling 'trans' with ICU formatted messages
items.description: Documented Symfony Translator ICU message support alongside symfony#37371.

items.title: Add aur-update2, a simple pikaur based update checker
items.description: Added an aur-update2 i3blocks module that surfaces pending AUR upgrades via pikaur.

items.title: Add `php-align` recipe
items.description: Packaged `php-align` for MELPA with a recipe covering its PHP alignment rules. Closed once the thread led to `php-align.el` being merged into `php-mode` instead

items.title: Add option to allow single line functions (in the braces category)
items.description: Added a PHP CS Fixer option to keep single-line autogenerated getters and setters.

items.title: Fixed small errors in clean build
items.description: Fixed IncludeOS build-system issues blocking a clean CI build.

items.title: Fix broken functions
items.description: Repaired a php-cs-fixer wrapper for Emacs, swapping its broken patch step for a direct file fix and a buffer revert.

items.title: Add a `-p`/`--parents` option to `git mv`
items.description: Lets `git mv` create missing leading directories in the destination instead of failing: `git mv -p foo bar/quux/` creates `bar/` and `bar/quux/` first, then moves `foo` into place.

items.title: Add `restore.defaultDestination` option
items.description: Argued for `restore.defaultDestination` on the Git mailing list (mirrored as git/git#1467) so users control where restored files land during recovery.

items.title: bbswitch
items.description: Fixed bbswitch kernel-module packaging and build issues for NVIDIA GPU power switching in a personal fork, never submitted upstream.

items.title: gnufm
items.description: Fixed and extended GNU FM (Libre.fm) PHP code in a fork of the Savannah-hosted music platform, never submitted upstream.
